speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, could you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Have you noticed any lumps elsewhere on your body, or have you experienced any shortness of breath or coughing?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: That description of a fixed, painless supraclavicular node is concerning for malignancy. Do you have any history of smoking, alcohol use, or exposure to tuberculosis?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The abdominal fullness and fixed supraclavicular lymph node strongly suggest metastatic disease, possibly gastric or lymphoma. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CT_Scan, Biopsy_Lymph_Node
